text:
Alex: hi all  i wanted to flag that i've been having chronic migraines that flare unpredictably. i'm finding full days of meetings really hard and i'm asking about a permanent part-time or flexible-hours accommodation (e.g., 30 hrs/week, no back-to-back meetings, and ability to log offline during episodes).

Priya_Manager: thanks for telling us, Alex. i'm glad you flagged it. from the team's POV, your ownership of the X launch has slipped a bit and we had a missed deadline last sprint. i want to support you but need to also understand how to keep deliverables covered. can we coordinate with People Ops on a plan?

Riley_PeopleOps: thanks both. Alex, i'm sorry to hear that. People Ops can initiate an accommodation review. please fill the intake here: https://redwoodhr.example/ada-intake and attach any docs you want to share (medical note optional). while we do that, we can set interim adjustments (meeting caps, async-first communication). Priya, we can work on a temporary coverage plan for critical milestones.

Alex: done, i submitted the intake and attached a short note from my neurologist that recommends flexible scheduling and no more than 3 hrs of consecutive screen time before breaks.

HR-Bot: Case opened: ADA-2024-318. Assigned: Riley_PeopleOps. Confidentiality: restricted to People Ops + Priya_Manager + Alex unless Alex authorizes. Expected turnaround: 5 business days.

Priya_Manager: noted. Alex, could you outline which recurring meetings you'd like reduced or handed off? Sam_HRAdvisor: any guidance on temporary performance support vs formal PIP here?

Sam_HRAdvisor: Hi Priya  performance concerns are separate from accommodation requests but should be coordinated. we recommend an initial 30-day trial accommodation with clear checkpoints and a documented support plan before considering formal performance steps. People Ops can help draft the plan and check-ins.

Taylor_Peer: i can take Alex's weekly syncs and own the bug triage for the next two sprints. happy to pair on handoff notes.

Alex: thanks Taylor  i'll DM the handoff checklist tonight. also request that meetings be recorded when possible and agendas shared 24h in advance.

Riley_PeopleOps: interim adjustments effective immediately: max 3 hrs meeting/day, 30 min breaks every 90 mins, and meeting-free mornings on Tue/Thu. we'll draft a 30-day accommodation agreement (flex hrs + meeting limits) and include success metrics and touchpoints. draft ETA: 2024-04-12.

Priya_Manager: i approve the interim adjustments. i'll reassign high-risk deliverables to ensure no single point of failure and update the roadmap. can we add a weekly 1:1 check-in to track workload?

Alex: 1:1 sounds good. thanks for being flexible. i worry about stigma so appreciate keeping this minimal distribution.

Riley_PeopleOps: understood. distribution: People Ops + Priya only. we'll log notes in the HR case and share the accommodation agreement privately.

Sam_HRAdvisor: also flagging benefits info: short-term disability and FMLA may be options if leave is needed; we can review later if it becomes relevant.

HR-Bot: Action items created: HR-ACT-892 (draft accommodation agreement), IT-ACT-657 (enable call recordings + auto-transcripts for Alex's calendar), ENG-ACT-441 (reassign deliverables). Owners: Riley, IT, Priya.

Taylor_Peer: added Alex's recurring review doc edits to the shared drive (link in DM).

Alex: thank you everyone. i'll update here if symptoms change. really appreciate the quick response.

Riley_PeopleOps: we'll post the draft agreement in 5 business days and set a review call for 7 days after that. leaving this thread open until agreement signed. :white_check_mark:
